case_number: 2025 INSC 194; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No(s). 7887 of 2024)
summary: Quashing of criminal proceedings; allegations under IPC s.269, s.270, s.504; no prima facie case for criminal liability; verbal reprimand without mens rea; failure to provide PPE kits not criminal negligence; Bhajan Lal guidelines applied; High Court erred in dismissing quashing petition; abuse of process established.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.269, s.270, s.504
State of Haryana v. Bhajan Lal
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; criminal proceedings quashed; chargesheet and cognizance set aside.
